svg.title: Engine Configuration panel — where the model list and the usage percentages actually come from
svg.text: Engine Configuration — no hardcoded model list, no hardcoded provider list, no invented percentage
Left: the picker is a UNION of three real sources, each reporting its own reachability. Right: the shares are counted from the hash-chained audit trail, offline.
GET /v1/console/v1/engine/claude-models
doubled prefix is real (client BASE + router path) · one fetch, deduped across all four cards
registry — curated engine_model_registry.yaml (the offline floor)
os_models + worker_models of every Claude-serving engine · 12 ids on this host
anthropic_live — GET {base_url}/v1/models, paginated
keyless Claude Code subscription login → reported as an ABSENT key · no egress attempted
bedrock_live — ListFoundationModels + ListInferenceProfiles
SigV4 signed by aws_sigv4.py (stdlib only, signed GET only — not an AWS client)
40 Claude ids on this host · us.anthropic.claude-* IS what /model offers here
union by id · every source keeps its own reachable / count / error / detail
47 ids here · default_model_id = the registry's `default: true`, never an array index
the CONFIGURED id is always offerable — dropping it would silently re-save another model
Console → Engine Configuration → Default Model
one <select> + one line PER SOURCE (✓ reachable · ⚠ unreachable, with its reason)
4 ids and 47 ids look identical in a dropdown — that line is the only difference visible
GET /v1/console/v1/engine/model-usage
read-only and OFFLINE — it runs on every page load, so it never fetches anything
tenant_audit_chain() — the only sanctioned resolver (ADR-0650)
no chain file yet → chain_readable:false, the honest zero state of a fresh install
count SPANS, keyed by span_id
engine.span.start / engine.span.end · os_turn.completed is the only token source
turn_id would MERGE an OS turn with the worker turn it delegated to, under one model
resolve the provider — strongest real source wins
live_catalog (it answered) > tenant_config (you assigned it) > registry (shipped)
then id_prefix (parsed from <provider>/<model>) · then engine_config (inferred)
nothing claims it → provider "unknown", provider_source "unresolved" — never guessed
Model Usage panel — by provider, then by model
bar width IS the percentage of ALL turns, never normalised to the top row
every row carries its provider_source badge: an inference must not read like a measurement
Refused by design:
no second usage counter (it would be a second truth against a legally load-bearing one, ADR-0232/0233) · no model or provider array in engine-config.tsx
(a constant is wrong on any Bedrock host) · ollama/llama3 stays unresolved — ollama_local vs ollama_cloud is a coin flip, and a coin flip is not data
